task.description: Design Stage 10 (Platform Repository) architecture. Create design document covering: content addressing (SHA-256), immutability enforcement, versioning with parent linkage, canonical JSON serialisation, form schema indexing, event type registry extension, service catalog, atomic multi-artifact activation, per-tenant activation scoping, activation history audit trail, and repository API endpoints (create artifact, list versions, tenant activations, bulk bundle operations).
acceptance_criteria: All MUST requirements have corresponding design elements
No implementation code present in design

result.summary: Designed Stage 10 repository architecture covering content addressing (SHA-256 hash-based storage), immutability enforcement, versioning with parent linkage, canonical JSON serialisation, form schema indexing and queryability, event type registry extension, service catalog with auth and endpoint validation, atomic multi-artifact activation per tenant with complete activation history audit trail, and all repository API endpoints (create artifact, list versions, tenant activations, bulk bundle operations).
